How custovox.ai calculates churn probability

PredictIQ combines multiple linguistic signals extracted from each customer's messages to produce a churn probability score from 0% to 100%, updated after each interaction.

+31 pts 💬

Lexical field

Detection of semantic fields associated with departure: 'alternative', 'competitor', 'looking for', 'switching to'

+18 pts 📊

Tone evolution

Tracking tone shift across successive messages: neutral → frustrated → detached

+24 pts 🔄

Recurrence patterns

Same problem mentioned multiple times: 'this is the third time', 'again', 'still not fixed'

+11 pts 📅

Temporal context

Proximity to renewal date combined with negative signals multiplies the score

FAQ

What data do you need to calculate churn probability?

Any text produced by your customers — support tickets, emails, in-app feedback, G2/Capterra reviews. The more messages per customer, the more precise the score. A minimum of 3 messages per customer is recommended.

Does this replace our CRM?

No — custovox.ai is complementary to your CRM. Your CRM tracks what customers do. custovox.ai reads what they say — and detects what they mean. The two work together.

How quickly do you detect a churn signal?

The score is updated after each new message or interaction. On average, custovox.ai detects departure signals 3 to 6 weeks before the cancellation request.
